column1: # The oracle reference's motor intensity per actuator byte: a measurement, not
# a derivation, and not a measurement of a DualShock motor.
# For each actuator byte the intensity (0..1, IEEE-754 single bits in hex) the
# reference test binary's port 1 analog controller (third_party/duckstation-
# patches, applied head aa982a3cbbdf7c20a625be907f21a7339ac4e5cc) hands its host input
# layer at its default settings, for the small and the large motor.
# Taken by tools/rumble_response_measure.py: the PS-EXE tools/rumble_probe/ sends
# every byte pair through the controller protocol (analog mode, byte 0 small
# motor, byte 1 large motor) under regtest -motor-log; 131588 logged
# changes cover all 65536 pairs for each motor, and each motor's intensity
# depends on its own byte alone.
# Regenerate (repo root, about ten seconds): tools/rumble_response_measure.py WORKDIR
